::: {.page-about name="Self-check (one lesson)" uses="the last five minutes of a lesson; students rate each I can, then show it; an exit ticket on paper" pieces="self-check, work-space, blank, recall"}
:::

**Before you leave:** colour the stars for each line. **离开教室前：**给每一行涂星星。

## 1. I can …

::: {.self-check lesson="true"}
- name five kinds of angle. 说出五种角的名称。
- find angles around me. 找到身边的角。
- compare angles with *bigger than* and *smaller than*. 用 *bigger than* 和 *smaller than* 比较角。
:::

## 2. Show me

Draw an angle **bigger than** a right angle. Name it: {{< blank 4cm answer="obtuse" >}}

::: {.work-space height="45mm" style="dots"}
:::

## 3. One sentence

::: {.recall lines="2"}
- Use this frame: *A … angle is … than a right angle.* | An acute angle is smaller than a right angle.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
**Look-fors:** a 1 or 2 on any line: see that student first next lesson. Part 2: an obtuse angle (or a straight or full angle, with a reason). Part 3: the frame used with *bigger* or *smaller*, and an angle name that matches.
:::
